reference: Duval, M., Zhao, J.-X. (2021). Combined U-series/ESR dating of fossil teeth from Olieboomspoort (Limpopo Province, South Africa). Unpublished technical report to SAHRA, permit 2861 (permit holder: Aurore Val), February 2021.

conventions.beta_attenuation: Monte-Carlo beta attenuation factors from Marsh 1999
conventions.radon_loss: Post-Rn equilibrium considered in dental tissues and sediment (no radon loss)
conventions.cosmic: Computed (Prescott & Hutton-type); report says depth was the main source of uncertainty; depth/lat/long/alt values not printed; cosmic value not printed separately (only gamma+cosmic)
conventions.gamma_source: Calculated from U, Th, K of dry raw sediment by ICP-OES/MS (four-acid digest); no in situ gamma measurement

samples.provenance: Table 3 (pp. 4-5), 'Data inputs and outputs corresponding to the combined US-ESR age calculations'; U-series inputs from Table 2 (p. 3); De from SSE fitting (Table 1, p. 2) with 2.3% source-calibration error added
samples.notes: Enamel water 0%. Enamel removed on sediment side = 'Removed thickness' printed in the Sediment block (158 ± 16); removed on dentine side printed in Dentine block as 'Removed enamel thickness' (152 ± 15). 'Initial enamel thickness' 1143 ± 114 µm (before removal). p values printed without errors. Report also mentions CSUS-ESR ages computed with DATA, 2-3% older than US-ESR, but numbers not printed. Enamel U printed '0.098 ± 0.000' (Table 2 gives 0.0979 ± 0.0003). | Verified: components sum to 1148, printed total 1141 (the age uses 1141).

samples.provenance: Table 3 (pp. 4-5); U-series data Table 2 (p. 3); De Table 1 (p. 2)
samples.notes: Outer side is cement (geometry cement/enamel/dentine per text). In the Cement block of Table 3 the rows are LABELLED 'U (ppm)', 'Th (ppm)', 'K (%)' with values 5.370 ± 0.001, 1.523 ± 0.001, 0.450 ± 0.000; these appear to be a label typo: 1.523 equals cement 234U/238U in Table 2 and 0.450 equals 230Th/238U(0.686)/234U/238U(1.523), i.e. 230Th/234U. Transcribed here as u234_u238 and th230_u234 -- verify. 'beta_sediment' here is the beta dose from cement ('Beta dose rate, sediment or cement'); its error (± 2) was read in one pass and cut off in another. 'p_cementum' is an extra key (not in schema). No sediment removed thickness (n.a.).

completeness: partial: no depth/cosmic value printed separately (gamma+cosmic only); CSUS ages not printed; water basis not stated
extraction_notes: Read via WebFetch (small-model PDF reading) four times with different prompts; Table 3 values consistent across reads. Values copied as printed. The sediment block 'Removed thickness' (#536) and cement block 'Removed thickness' (#537) mapped to removed_outer_um; the dentine block 'Removed enamel thickness' mapped to removed_inner_um.
